probe.title: Turn your metal waste into revenue – Sun Metalon
probe.text_sample: Turn your metal waste into revenue – Sun Metalon Home Company News Careers Contact EN 日本語 Scrap In. Supply Out. Scrap In. Supply Out. Metal regeneration for foundries and manufacturers. Working with metal creates a hidden asset: scrap. Up to 20% of produced metal is lost as swarf, dust, chips, sludges, and grindings at scrap-generating factories. On-site regeneration units installed at these plants clean, densify, and standardize this scrap, turning it into traceable, high-grade metal supply for downstream buyers and EAF furnaces. The result is recovered value in the form of purified feedstock briquettes that stay in your supply chain. Contact Us Generating value from scrap Built for all metals and manufacturers On-site metal regeneration without third-party handling or long-term scrap storage.
